ppet": "Short answer: keep one consolidated OS file, but keep EvidenceChain as its own append-only log. That gives you a clean “single source of truth” for the runtime plus a slim, high-velocity audit trail that never forces a full OS re-ship.
Recommendation

#1 OS file (consolidated): MetaBlooms_OS_v18.X_FULL.mips.json

#2 Evidence log (append-only): _logs/EvidenceChain.jsonl

Why this split

Stability: OS is versioned, immutable between builds; the log grows independently.
